Open.description: The degree to which a person is curious, imaginative and open-minded.
Open.spirit_animal: Dolphin-playful, adventurous, intelligent, and creative creatures of the sea
Open.ideal_vaction: Backpacking throught the mountains, exploring nature and discovering hidden gems along the way
Open.famous_character: Willy Wonka- a creative and imaginative character who defies convention and embraces his unque ideas.
Open.power_song: 'Imagine' byJohn Lennon - a song that celebrates the power of imagination and creativity

Conscientious.description: The degree to which a person is organised,responsible and self disciplined.
Conscientious.spirit_animal: Ant - an incredibly organised and efficient insect that values teamwork and is always focussed on achieving its goals
Conscientious.ideal_vaction: Planning a meticulously detailed itinearary for a trip to an exciting new destination, and executing it flawlessly
Conscientious.famous_character: Hermione Ganger- an intelligent and detail-oriented character who values hard work and dedication
Conscientious.power_song: 'Eye of the Tiger' by Survivor - a song that celebrates the determination and the drive to achieve

Extravert.description: The degree to which a person is outgoing, assertive and sociable.
Extravert.spirit_animal: Butterfly- a social and outgoing creature that loves to contest with others and spread joy wherever it goes
Extravert.ideal_vaction: A weekend gateaway with a group of close friends, filled with lively conversation, fun activites and losts of laughter
Extravert.famous_character: Tony Stark (Iron Man) - a charismatic and outgoing character who loves to be the center of attention and thrives in social situations
Extravert.power_song: 'Don't Stop Beiievin' by Journey - a song that celebrates the joy of connecting with others and the power of optimism

Aggreable.description: The degree to which a person is empathetic,cooperative and trusting.
Aggreable.spirit_animal: Elephant- a kind and genetic creature that values its herd and shows empathy and kindness to all around it
Aggreable.ideal_vaction: Volunteering in an developing country, working with a team to make a difference and help those in need
Aggreable.famous_character: Forest Gump -a compassionate and friendly character who always looks out for the best intersts of those around him
Aggreable.power_song: 'Lean On Me' by Bill Wethers - a song that celebrates the power of human connection and the importance of supporting each other

Neurotic.description: The degree to which a person is introspective, sensitive and emotional
Neurotic.spirit_animal: Cat - a sensitive and emotional creature that can be moody and unpredictable, but is also fiercly independent and adaptable
Neurotic.ideal_vaction: A retreat to a quiet and peacful villa, where you can soak up the ocean views and reflect on your mental and emotional well-being
Neurotic.famous_character: Hamlet - a complex and emotional character who struggles with his own thoughts and feelings.
Neurotic.power_song: 'Shake It out' by Fiorence + The Machine - a song that encourages letting go of negative emotions and embracing positivity and self-acceptance.
